name: SGang Gwaay
description: On a small island off the southwest coast of Haida Gwaii, in British Columbia, SGang Gwaay (also called Ninstints) is a former Haida village. Weathered cedar mortuary and memorial poles still lean along the shore, beside the remains of longhouses. Within Gwaii Haanas, the site is cared for by the Haida, and it gives a rare view of their art, traditions and ties to the sea.
